issues.title: "Mark as read" / "Mark all as read" not working
issues.body:
In formatted messages, once a player has expanded a message, it is marked as read.

At the top of a channel, the player is able to mark all messages as read.

Here is a recording of an old (2019) instance of Serge:
![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/93612cf85ebf037e03687c5d3555b77f.gif)

The UI is still present to trigger these actions, but the messages don't get marked as read.

comments.body: Re-opening this for @sanjayradadiya  to implement persistent mark-as-read between sessions.
